tools.name: lint_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Fetch a URL, expect an HTTP 402 response, and validate the JSON body against the x402 protocol shape (x402Version, accepts[] fields, resource/description). Free, no account. Returns a pass/fail report with concrete errors and warnings.

tools.name: deep_lint_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Cross-checks a target's live 402 body against its /.well-known/x402.json manifest (payTo/asset/network mismatches). Requires payment (0.01 USDC on Base, x402) -- NOT callable for free over MCP. Calling this tool returns the exact HTTP request to make instead; it does not run the check itself. See GE

tools.name: conform_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Live adversarial test: fires malformed/garbage/fake payment proofs at a target to see if any trick it into returning 200 without a real payment. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lint_x402_endpoint, deep_lint_x402_endpoint, conform_x402_endpoint · Public sink: deep_lint_x402_endpoint, conform_x402_endpoint · Destructive: deep_lint_x402_endpoint, conform_x402_endpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lint_x402_endpoint, deep_lint_x402_endpoint, conform_x402_endpoint · Public sink: deep_lint_x402_endpoint, conform_x402_endpoint · Destructive: deep_lint_x402_endpoint, conform_x402_endpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
